mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.price, p.image_url, p.status, p.stock_quantity, p.main_category, p.manufacturer, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT oi.ql_id), 0) as order_count FROM tbl_products p LEFT JOIN tbl_order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN tbl_orders o ON oi.ql_id = o.ql_id AND o.order_status NOT IN ('READY', 'CANCELLED') AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) WHERE p.status = 'O' AND p.main_category = #{category} GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.price, p.image_url, p.status, p.stock_quantity, p.main_category, p.manufacturer ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size}
SELECT option_id, option_name, option_price, option_stock, is_base_option as baseOption FROM tbl_product_options WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY is_base_option DESC, option_name ASC
